violated_contract: An integration client must only send to a backend route that the backend actually registers; hard-coding a version or path the server does not serve fails every call with 404 and the feature dies silently, because the failure surfaces only as a logged error string. hume-ai's create_omi_memory posted to /v1/integrations/{app_id}/memories while the backend only serves POST /v2/integrations/{app_id}/user/memories, so every emotion-memory import failed (issue #14340).
canonical_prevention: Pin the exact served route in a manifest-registered hermetic suite that drives the real client function through a capturing fake HTTP client and asserts the full URL, so drift to an unserved route fails CI before merge.
